_comment: AP3 evidence corpus, version 1: official Federal Reserve and statistical-agency documents only (proposal D7/B1). Each family lists where its documents are listed, how a document URL is formed, and how its first-publication time (available_at) is read from the document itself. URL patterns and index pages are verified on first acquisition: the fetcher records the HTTP status and SHA-256 of every response and stops on any family whose index does not yield the expected count.
user_agent: Protofin research corpus builder (public official documents; contact via the repository owner)

fomc_statement.available_at_rule: release time printed on the page ('For release at H:MM a.m./p.m. EST/EDT') on the statement date; default 14:00 ET for scheduled statements
fomc_statement.verified_2026-10-28: URL pattern and printed release times confirmed (2019-07-31 2:00 p.m.; 2020-03-03 10:00 a.m.; 2020-03-15 5:00 p.m.)

fomc_minutes.available_at_rule: minutes release date from the FOMC calendar page, 14:00 ET
fomc_minutes.release_date_search: the 'Released <Month d, yyyy>' label next to the minutes link: after it on the current calendar page, before it ('Minutes (Released April 10, 2019): HTML') on the historical pages
fomc_minutes.verified_2026-10-28: 8 minutes links per year on each historical page 2015-2020; 46 links with release dates on the current calendar page (2021-2026)

bls_employment_situation.available_at_rule: embargo line in the release ('embargoed until 8:30 a.m. (ET) <weekday>, <Month> <d>, <yyyy>')
bls_employment_situation.verified_2026-10-28: index lists 12 releases per year 2015-2024; embargo line matched on Employment Situation, CPI and PPI releases from 2015 and 2019

bls_cpi.available_at_rule: embargo line, as for the Employment Situation
bls_cpi.verified_2026-10-28: index lists 12 releases per year 2015-2024; embargo line matched on Employment Situation, CPI and PPI releases from 2015 and 2019

bls_ppi.available_at_rule: embargo line, as for the Employment Situation
bls_ppi.verified_2026-10-28: index lists 12 releases per year 2015-2024; embargo line matched on Employment Situation, CPI and PPI releases from 2015 and 2019

fed_g17_industrial_production.available_at_rule: release date in the URL at 09:15 ET (the G.17 release time)
fed_g17_industrial_production.verified_2026-10-28: release_dates.htm lists release dates as d-Month-yyyy (no links); /releases/g17/20190716/default.htm returns the release

census_advance_retail_sales.available_at_rule: release date and time printed on the first page ('... RELEASED AT 8:30 A.M. EDT, <WEEKDAY>, <MONTH> <D>, <YYYY>')
census_advance_retail_sales.verified_2026-10-28: historical page lists 850 PDFs named adv<yymm>.pdf through adv2608; the release line on page 1 is checked at build time (a document without one is rejected for manual review)
census_advance_retail_sales.parsing_note: 2026-10-29: text is whitespace-normalised before matching (non-breaking spaces; PDF extraction splits such as 'ED T'), and the 2014-12..2016-11 layout ('FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE <WEEKDAY>, <MONTH D, YYYY>, AT 8:30 A.M. EDT', date before time) is read by embargo_regex_date_first. The rule is unchanged: the release time printed in the document.

excluded.ISM Manufacturing Report on Business: not an official agency document and published under ISM copyright; AP3 uses its surprise value from the macro panel only
excluded.news and commentary: outside the frozen AP3 (proposal D7); a news layer would be a later version evaluated prospectively
